Add files a friction entry: a one-line summary of what got in your way,
optionally with a kind and more detail.

If your last failed agent command (same AGENT_NAME, or for a person, same
directory) ran in the past 15 minutes, it's copied into the entry, and add
says so; --no-command skips it.

If the summary is close to an open or accepted entry's, add doesn't file:
it lists the matches and exits 3. "agent friction +1 ID" adds your vote to
one of them; --new files yours anyway.

Usage:
  agent friction add "summary" [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction add "send's help doesn't say the message is typed into the terminal" --kind help
  agent friction add "no way to wait for several agents at once" --kind missing --detail "..."
  agent friction add "status says unknown for aider agents" --kind bug --detail-file notes.md --new

Flags:
      --detail string        More detail
      --detail-file string   Read the detail from a file ("-" for stdin)
  -h, --help                 help for add
      --kind string          Kind: other, help, error, missing, bug, docs (default "other")
      --new                  File even if it looks like an open entry
      --no-command           Don't attach your last failed command

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
